name: xuannv_china_quarterly_2020_2021_sampling
purpose: Build the frozen nationwide spatial registry shared by 2020Q1 through 2021Q4 embedding products.

implementation_status.reason: The legacy registry builder uses the 2025-2026 monthly policy schema and must not be run with this policy.

boundary.study_area: China land area and included islands under the project-approved boundary
boundary.candidate_predicate: patch center is inside the frozen study boundary
boundary.utm_owner_rule: assign the center longitude to exactly one half-open UTM zone; reject candidates outside their owner zone
boundary.cross_zone_overlap_check: reject or deterministically replenish any pair with footprint intersection over 1 percent of either patch area

patch.grid: UTM-zone-local metric grid aligned to a frozen origin for each zone

sampling.base_count_status: realized provisional center-point count for seed 20260717; not an exact equal-probability quota
sampling.base_inclusion_probability_status: initial design probability; fixed-size cross-zone reconciliation changes boundary probabilities slightly
sampling.final_land_fraction_status: area-based planning estimate; exact fraction is recomputed after cross-zone de-overlap and integer candidate enumeration
sampling.base_rule: Within each 10 x 10 patch macrocell, enumerate the exact number n of owner-zone candidate centers inside the frozen boundary. Map a domain-separated SHA-256 hash of seed, boundary version and macrocell id to [0,1); accept when u < n / 100. After acceptance choose the domain-separated patch hash winner. Then resolve cross-zone overlap and deterministically replenish from the ranked base reserve until the fixed planning count 57,405 is restored.

layers.selection: deterministic macrocell hash with boundary acceptance correction

draw from all unselected patch candidates, including macrocells already containing a base point; allocate by square root of exact eligible owner-zone patch count; deterministic selection; at most one supplemental point across all supplement layers per macrocell

patch footprints that intersect both the frozen land polygon and an independent frozen ocean polygon; compute distance and area in a local metric CRS; allocate across coastal UTM zones and audit provinces

jointly allocate unique patches from four ranked pools using broad land-cover, historical OSM, DEM and source-quality summaries; a patch has one primary quota class and may retain multiple secondary reasons; do not use final downstream manual labels

quality_gate.quarter_intervals: half-open calendar quarters; do not borrow observations across quarter boundaries
quality_gate.optical_selection: quality-screen observations, then build a medoid composite from valid pixels within the same quarter

status_levels.partial: at least one optical source and one additional modality pass; missing targets are masked
status_levels.quarantined: quarter does not meet partial thresholds or registration fails

quality_gate.failed_patch_action: record source, quarter and reason in the image-data repair queue; use the frozen same-stratum reserve only before final registry freeze
quality_gate.sentinel_1_product_contract: RTC, IW mode, VV and VH, fixed orbit-direction policy, fixed DEM and fixed linear-or-dB units

sources: ESA WorldCover 2020 and 2021 as annual broad-class supervision only
Dynamic World 2020 and 2021 as confidence-masked same-source pseudo labels only
OSM full-history extracts reconstructed at each quarter end from 2020-03-31 through 2021-12-31
